claims.brief_justification: The single rectangular block in IMAGE C lies mostly in the center-left cell (about two thirds of its width), with a smaller sliver crossing into the center cell; IMAGE D outlines the same area.

The annotated area covers the skateboard/wheel zone, and the content there differs between IMAGE A and IMAGE B (footwear and lower-body detail around the deck are not the same), so alteration in that region is consistent with the evidence; 'significant' is an overstatement given the marked block is only ~4% of the frame and no seam or tonal step is clearly visible at the boundary under the heavy sepia grade and low resolution.
